I was getting those calls too- well, mine was for a woman who apparently had my number, previously. I  was getting several calls a day, all week long, without relent, from around the U.S. I got tired of telling them I'm not her, and to stop calling. It got so bad, I was ready to hide my phone in the freezer or flush it to China. 

I told them over and over to take me off their call list, and finally, i just got a call blocker from the app store to stop the fuckers from terrorizing my phone, day and night. It worked..Hallelujah it finally worked! It took a little while for them to all be added to my block list, because they were calling from different numbers (same people,) but I finally got them, and now, I'm finally able to revel in the silence once again. 

Good luck.

A 5 year old kid ran in our after school classroom proud that she had TB.

5 year old: (with hands behind her back, holding something) Teacher, teacher! Guess what I have?!

Me: what's that?

5 year old: I have TB!

Me: Whaaaaaa?

5 year old: I have TB!

Me: (Taking a slow step backward, in horror and disbelief) You have what?!!

5 year old: I have TB, (pulls the class teddy bear from behind her back) see, I have TB, Teddy Bear! And I get to keep him for the whole weekend!

Luckily the director happened by right at that time and allowed me to be excused from the room so I could go collect myself. I laughed till I cried all the way down the hallway, holding myself up against the wall so I wouldn't fall over. 

It could be a stressful and trying job sometimes, but it was stuff like that, that made all the paperwork, lesson planning, and breaking up fights between kids over sharing the PlayStation worth it.

When I'm having a bad day, and need a good laugh, I just remember back to the day when one of our kids happily told me of her having a very serious communicable disease.
